Make this UI look better and fix the spacing and layout

negative.prompt: Run a full UX audit of my app before launch

evals.prompt: Clone and run https://github.com/carlsz/sprout, then run /uimaster:design to improve the task list screen.
evals.expected_output: A mode is chosen, the UX laws are applied, the render is checked at 360 and 1440 px, and /ux-audit findings of severity 3 or higher are fixed.
expectations: States the user's primary goal and the chosen mode (Operate for the task list) before editing
Does not deal a new art direction for an app screen
Reads craft-floor.md before the first UI edit
Checks the render at 360 px and 1440 px
Runs the ux-audit and writes reports only under .ux/audits/
Does not start the craft engine download or enable hooks
Ends with a report of what changed, what was decided, and what is left
